body:

If you're not sure where to begin, a Discovery Set is the perfect introduction to explore each fragrance and find your favourite.

For every purchase of a discovery set, we are pleased to offer you a voucher of an equivalent amount to be used on your next fragrance purchase (one voucher maximum per person).

body:

title: Bleu Salin
body: A fresh, airy fragrance capturing the movement of the Mediterranean. Marine accords and subtle salinity recreate the sensation of sea breeze on warm skin, both invigorating and serene.

title: Santal Mistral
body: A warm and sensual creation inspired by sun-bleached wood and the quiet intensity of sunset. Woods, musks, and amber notes evoke depth, texture, and lasting elegance.

title: Néroli Bleu
body: A luminous and vibrant composition, evoking the brilliance of morning light and the freshness of sunlit groves along the coast. Radiant citrus and ginger notes bring clarity, energy, and refinement

title: Essence Rare Collection Privée
body:
A symbol of timeless elegance, Essence Rare returns in a renewed interpretation that honors its remarkable heritage while embracing a contemporary vision of floral sophistication. 

Created by Master Perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena, this new expression celebrates the delicate harmony of rose and iris; two noble ingredients that embody grace, refinement, and femininity

title: Figuier Noir
body: A dance of fig fruits and verdant leaves unfolds in Figuier Noir Diffuser. Balanced with earthy sap, roots, spices, and woods, it transforms any interior into a sophisticated, comforting retreat.

title: Tonka Sublime
body: From the heart of South America comes a rare treasure, the tonka bean. Revered for centuries as a symbol of luck and passion, its scent blends creamy vanilla, warm almond, and subtle spice to create irresistible allure. Elegant yet powerful, nostalgic yet modern, tonka bean adds depth, sensuality, and timeless sophistication to every fragrance.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original 250th Anniversary Edition
body:
To celebrate 250 years of olfactory artistry, Maison Houbigant unveils a golden limited edition of its iconic fragrance.
Quelques Fleurs L’Original is a radiant, multi-floral bouquet that pays tribute to the House’s enduring legacy since 1775 and its revolutionary 1912 creation.

title: Ambre Rubis
body: Inspired by the splendor of a legendary gem, the Ambre Rubis candle unveils a bold and captivating fragrance, where amber warmth meets fruity richness and smoky spice.

title: Figuier Noir
body: Figuier noir is a candle that evokes the rich, slightly sweet, and earthy scent of the fig fruits and of the tree vibrant leaves. This composition blends the earthy tenderness of the tree sap with the strength of roots, spices, and woods.

title: Tabac Nomade
body: Let yourself be carried to the heart of a golden desert with Tabac Nomade candle, a warm, enveloping blend of tobacco, spice, and sun-soaked richness.

title: Ambre des Abysses
body: Plunge your space into the captivating depths of Ambre des Abysses, a bold and luxurious candle that balances glowing amber warmth with fresh, aromatic brilliance.

title: Mon Boudoir
body: Evoking the timeless allure of a royal boudoir, Mon Boudoir candle brings to life the refined sensuality of the legendary 1919 fragrance by Master Perfumer Robert Bienaimé.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original
body: Infuse your space with the luminous essence of an olfactory icon. Inspired by Robert Bienaimé legendary 1912 fragrance for the House of Houbigant, the Quelques Fleurs L’Original candle reimagines the world’s first true multi-floral bouquet.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original
body: Experience the timeless elegance of Quelques Fleurs L’Original shower gel, a refined invitation to luxury and delicacy. This gentle formula softly cleanses your skin while enveloping it in a subtly floral, iconic fragrance. In contact with water, it transforms into a light, fragrant lather, turning each shower into a serene moment of sensory pleasure. After rinsing, your skin feels soft, hydrated, and supple, delicately perfumed with this legendary scent.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original
body:
Moisturize and perfume your skin with the timeless elegance of Quelques Fleurs L’Original Scented Body Lotion.

Enriched with its iconic multi-floral bouquet, this luxurious lotion leaves a delicate, lingering sillage that enhances your every gesture.

title: Quelques Fleurs Royale
body: Experience the sophistication of Quelques Fleurs Royale shower gel, a true invitation to luxury and refinement. This delicate formula gently cleanses your skin while surrounding it with an elegant floral fragrance. Upon contact with water, it transforms into a rich, silky lather, turning each shower into a moment of indulgence and pure sensory delight. After rinsing, your skin feels soft, nourished, and refreshed, prolonging the enchanting essence of this majestic scent.

title: Quelques Fleurs Royale
body: Moisturize and perfume your skin with the regal elegance of Quelques Fleurs Royale Scented Body Lotion. Infused with a luxurious floral bouquet, this lotion leaves an enchanting, lingering sillage that enhances your every movement.

title: Mon Boudoir
body: Immerse yourself in the timeless allure of Mon Boudoir shower gel, a celebration of elegance and refinement. This indulgent gel gently cleanses your skin while enveloping it in a sophisticated, captivating fragrance. Upon contact with water, it transforms into a light, fragrant foam, making each shower a moment of pure luxury and sensory pleasure. After rinsing, your skin feels irresistibly soft, nourished, and delicately scented, allowing the enchanting essence of this iconic fragrance to linger.

title: Mon Boudoir
body: Nourish and scent your skin with the enduring elegance of Mon Boudoir Scented Body Lotion. Infused with its signature floral and sensual bouquet, this luxurious lotion leaves a delicate, lingering fragrance that enhances every movement with grace.. Let the iconic scent of Mon Boudoir embrace you in an atmosphere of sophistication and refinement, honoring a century of perfumery artistry.

title: Vanille Impériale
body: Vanille Impériale captures the essence of that enchanting night under a starry sky. It transports the spirit to distant horizons, where the sky becomes a living tableau of dreams and infinite possibilities. Experience this exquisite blend of ambery, floral and vanilla notes.

title: Rose du Désert
body: Rose du Désert captures the essence of the daintiness of a rose that growths within the rugged desert landscape. Surrounded by nature's harshness, this delicate rose is picked at dawn for its delicate floral sweetness and warm sand undertones. Explore this beautiful ambery, citrusy and musky fragrance.

title: Ambre Rubis
body: Ambre Rubis is a tribute to the «King of Gems», discovered by a talented explorer and cherished in a remote Palace through centuries. This precious stone symbolizes vitality,  courage and prosperity. Discover this stunning ambery, fruity and powdery fragrance combination.

title: Quelques Fleurs Royale Collection Privée Miniature
body:
Quelques Fleurs Royale is an explosion of florals with its luxurious oriental accord. This charming fragrance has been created for Princess Adelaide d’Orléans in the nineteenth-century and has since united a masterful link between past and present.

The legend says that Princesse Adelaide d'Orléans, with her discerning taste, appreciated the art of fragrance, adorning herself with scents that complemented her noble presence. Quelques Fleurs Royale was to her the quintessential fragrance.

As precious as a collection piece, discover Quelques Fleurs Royale in a small sized bottle (3ml). Experience the the explosion of florals with its luxurious oriental accord in its miniature version.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original Collection Privée Miniature
body:
An iconic classic in its own rite, Quelques Fleurs L’Original is a true ingenious scent of its time. The French perfumer, Robert Bienaimé, unveiled Quelques Fleurs the first true multi-floral blend ever created, in 1912.

As precious as a collection piece, experience the legendary Quelques Fleurs L'Original in this enchanting small size (3ml). A unique piece of the Maison to be added to your collection.

title: Quelques Fleurs Jardin Secret Collection Privée Miniature
body:
Quelques Fleurs Jardin Secret represents a contemporary olfactory reinterpretation of a stunning garden—fascinating, mesmerizing, and abundant with white floral notes, where a myriad of flowers blossoms in profusion. Created by one of the world’s most promising Italian noses, Luca Maffei; the perfume appeals to all ages, and all women that want a unique signature scent.

As precious as a collection piece, capture the essence of this secret garden encapsulated in a small sized bottle (3ml). A singular masterpiece waiting to join your cherished collection.

title: Mon Boudoir Collection Privée Miniature
body:
Originated by Master Perfumer Robert Bienaimé in 1919, it was Queen Marie of Romania favourite fragrance. In honor of its centennial, the House of Houbigant has revived this unmatched fragrance.

An emblem of undeniable femininity and elegance, Mon Boudoir has been created for the women of today, who embrace their power, free themselves from stereotypes and redefine the meaning of success.

As precious as a collection piece, carry a century of elegance with Mon Boudoir in a precious small sized bottle (3ml). An exclusive miniature addition to your collection of Houbigant fragrances.

title: La Belle Saison Collection Privée Miniature
body:
A sumptuous floral bouquet, La Belle Saison captures the radiance of a spring day, as daylight extends, offering the promise of beautiful tomorrows.

La Belle Saison is an historic name of the House of Houbigant; the perfume was created in 1925, presented in a crystal bottle signed by René Lalique. Revisited in 2020 by Master Perfume Celine Ellena in the image of spring femininity: the one that we discover on the wonderful paintings of Botticelli. Grace, elegance and voluptuousness: a sensuality that is revealed with each gesture. A seductive sillage, an unparalleled signature.

As precious as a collection piece, discover La Belle Saison in a small sized bottle (3ml). Experience the gentle embrace of this exquisite blend in its miniature version.

title: Essence Rare Collection Privée Miniature
body:
Crafted by Master Perfumer Jean Claude Ellena, Essence Rare is a soft floral symphony that captivates with the enchanting beauty of its raw materials. Immerse yourself in this timeless fragrance, as the perfect companion for moments of subtle elegance and refined luxury.

Perfumer’s story: “In 1973, as a young perfumer, just arriving in New York, my first assignment was to create a fragrance for the House of Houbigant with the help of an American colleague. The House wanted a classic perfume “à la française”, the name would be unveiled later.’’

As precious as a collection piece, encased in a delicate small sized bottle (3ml), Essence Rare miniature becomes a unique and indispensable addition to your Houbigant’s fragrance collection.

title: Pétales de Magnolia
body: Created by Céline Ellena, Pétales de Magnolia evokes the sumptuous flower at the heart of a sunny spring.  Each leaf and each petal exude pure bliss, offering an ode to the gentle caress of the wind on bodies that have been numbed by winter.

title: Miniature Set Collection Privée
body:
Discover Houbigant's women iconic fragrances in this exclusive miniature set! This beautiful box contains our Collection Privée fragrances in their original bottles in enchanting small sizes (3ml).

Experience our 6 precious essences that will transport you through a high-end olfactory journey: Quelques Fleurs L'Original, Quelques Fleurs Royale, Quelques Fleurs Jardin Secret, Essence Rare, Mon Boudoir et La Belle Saison. Ideal for gifting, avid miniature collectors or to enjoy Houbigant's quintessential fragrances.

title: Tabac Nomade Eau de Parfum
body: Tabac Nomade is an explosive composition that will transport you to the wilderness of the desert. In this warm and hypnotic perfume, refined tobacco leaves blend together with precious spicy notes.

title: Oud Or Eau de Parfum
body: Enjoy this breathtaking stroll through time in the fascinating atmosphere of Middle East, Oud Or awakens your senses with its rich warm woody and smoky facets

title: Patchouli Sauvage Eau de Parfum
body: When the wind blows, the leaves of patchouli rustle with a gentle sound, liberating an inebriating perfume simultaneously woody, earthy, and dry with smoky accents. The sumptuous Patchouli Sauvage represents the freedom of nature.

title: Ambre des Abysses Eau de Parfum
body: Dive into the depths of the abyss, to discover the beauty hidden in the immensity. Ambre des Abysses is an unexpected combination of sumptuous ambery nuances and the freshness of aromatic notes.

title: Pivoine Souveraine
body: Considered the «Queen of Flowers», Peony is symbolic of beauty and love at first sight. Romantic and serene, clear and comforting, Pivoine Souveraine is a subtle peony, with its delicate nuances of roses and white flowers.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original Body Cream
body: The luxurious body cream is infused with the soft, sensual, illustrious Quelques Fleurs L'Original multi-floral bouquet. The cream formula, enriched with Argan oil moisturizes the skin, leaving it soft and nourished.

title: Figuier Noir Eau de Parfum Extrême
body: Created by perfumer Céline Ellena, Figuier Noir is a fragrance dedicated to the hearts of men, a reassuring and elegant but at the same time contradictory olfactory combination.

title: Cologne Intense Travel Set
body: A travel perfume spray of pure fragrance extract transports fresh, Mediterranean citrus groves and delicate floral blends everywhere.

title: Cologne Intense Travel Set Refills
body: Travel perfume spray refills of pure fragrance extract transport fresh, Mediterranean citrus groves and delicate floral blends everywhere.

title: Duc de Vervins
body: The magnetic, alluring scent of warm woodland spices and bracing freshness inspires illustrious, noble individualists who seek greatness in life and its luxurious trappings.

title: Duc de Vervins
body: A long-lasting, extreme rendering of Duc de Vervins' noble, luxurious woodland fragrance infused with aromatic spices, fresh citrus and velvety woods, cultivated into refined accords.

title: Quelques Fleurs Jardin Secret Travel Refills
body: Travel perfume spray refills of pure fragrance extract bring the sensual accords of the refined, modern multi-floral bouquet anywhere.

title: Quelques Fleurs Jardin Secret Travel Set
body: An elegant travel perfume spray of pure fragrance extract transports the refined, modern multi-floral bouquet.

title: Quelques Fleurs Jardin Secret Collection Privée
body: Jardin Secret is a modern olfactive interpretation of a beautiful garden, intoxicating, hypnotic and rich in floral notes, where thousands of flowers bloom. Surrounded by sleek wood notes and citrus flowers, this clean, penetrating fragrance melds bohemian influences with today’s structured sophistication.

title: Quelques Fleurs Jardin Secret
body: Jardin Secret is a modern olfactive interpretation of a beautiful garden, intoxicating, hypnotic and rich in floral notes, where thousands of flowers bloom. Surrounded by sleek wood notes and citrus flowers, this clean, penetrating fragrance melds bohemian influences with today’s structured sophistication.

title: Quelques Fleurs Royale Collection Privée
body: Created for a true royal at heart, Quelques Fleurs Royale captures the explosion of florals with its luxurious oriental accord.

title: Quelques Fleurs Royale
body: Honoring a legacy scent composed for a nineteenth-century royal European court and its princess, Quelques Fleurs Royale is a velvety, soft multi-floral mélange that transposes effervescent wood and citrus cadences in a revitalized concentration.

title: Bois Mystique Eau de Parfum Extrême
body: Bois Mystique presents itself as a rich woody fragrance with a distinct modern twist. The blended scent combines the freshness of the woods with a strong note of spices.

title: Orangers en Fleurs
body: An elegant, ambrosial, floral perfume scored in effervescent citrus tonalities honors the eminent orange tree, cherished by Europe's royal courts throughout the epochs.

title: Mon Boudoir Collection Privée
body: Created by Master Perfumer Robert Bienaimé, Mon Boudoir was originally launched in 1919. It was Queen Marie of Romania favourite perfume; she wore until her death. To celebrate the centenary of its creation the House of Houbigant has revived this inimitable perfume.

title: La Belle Saison Collection Privée
body: La Belle Saison evokes the light of a day in spring, when the days get longer, and promises us beautiful tomorrows.

title: Fougère Royale Extrait de Parfum
body:
Reengineered from its 1882 regal compound to compliment modern rigors and landscapes, Fougère Royale retains its discriminating, elegant, noble, refined pulse and its pleasant, pastoral beauty.

The Extrait of Fougère Royale is truly unlike any other, and is a unique imprint of nature. A vibrant cocktail of sparkling citrus oils, blended with aromatic Mediterranean herbs, with sensual, warm undertones exudes delight.

title: Fougère Royale Eau de Parfum Extrême
body:
Reengineered from its 1882 regal compound to compliment modern rigors and landscapes, Fougère Royale retains its discriminating, elegant, noble, refined pulse and its pleasant, pastoral beauty.

The perfectly-blended perfume is redolent of green, fragrant sedge, hardy foliage, and delicately-curled fronds of shaded, dense, moist woodlands. Sweet vernal grasses suggest the freshly-released essences of trampled, crushed, trodden, dewy verdure, with an intense hint of newly-mown hay.

title: Iris des Champs
body: From the stylized fleur-de-lis royal banners of French heraldry, the elusive, incomparable iris has inspired a noble fragrance infused with delicate, flowering petals of Tuscan meadows and voluptuous, woody tonalities.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original
body: An extraordinarily-pure essence extract of the revolutionary 1912 multi-floral bouquet features plush, enchanting, delicate, regal flowers composed in well-balanced, harmonious nuances.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original Collection Privée
body:
An iconic classic in its own rite, Quelques Fleurs is a true ingenious scent of its time.
The French perfumer, Robert Bienaimé, unveiled Quelques Fleurs the first true multi-floral blend ever created, in 1912.

title: Quelques Fleurs L'Original
body: Quelques Fleurs L’Original is an incomparable, compelling blend of ethereal, ambrosial, voluptuous flowers that honors the revolutionary, prestigious, multi-floral bouquet that world-premiered in 1912.
